title: Ladder 6 · ut, nē, cum: pyramid 2 (× 2)
summary: Subjunctive pyramid 2, new sentences: Dīc fīliō meō ut domum veniat · Domum eō, ut cum līberīs cēnem · Timeō nē pīca mē oppugnet · Cum fessus essem, domī mānsī · Scīsne ubi sit cāseus? Slow steps, plain vs subjunctive contrasts, reviews (and pyramid 1's peaks), a funny rainy day at the end. Played twice. Free voice (IPA, v as v).
